expected_outcomes: Browser surfaces receive a minimal, complete, pinned operating context.
required_actions: Provide the seven required files, declared read order, pinned repositories, hashes, freshness, and privacy classification.
expected_documents: Browser project source pack and source manifest.
acceptance: Uploaded snapshots remain active context and stale packs report limitations without silent refresh.
verification: Validate pack completeness, read order, commit pins, hashes, and freshness.
evidence: Verified source manifest and writeback receipt when promotion occurs.
failure_conditions: File names imply undeclared precedence, content silently refreshes, or staged memory is claimed canonical.
exceptions: Provider adapters may describe mechanics but cannot alter policy semantics.
